name: Tokens: go wide
description: Lots of small creatures at once. White, green and red cards that make tokens, pump the whole team, help pay for big spells and keep your board safe from wipes.

cards.name: Aldine, Keeper of the Commons
cards.rule_text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
{1}, Tap three untapped creature tokens you control: Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Activate only once each turn.
cards.flavor_text: Her door is never shut, and her table is never empty.

cards.name: Rovanna, Drum of the Long March
cards.rule_text:
Vigilance, haste
Whenever you attack with three or more creatures, create a 1/1 red Warrior creature token that's tapped and attacking. Then creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Hearthguard Sergeant
cards.rule_text: Whenever you attack with two or more creatures, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
cards.flavor_text: "Two of us went out. Three of us came back. That's how it works here."

cards.name: Hedgerow Sproutcaller
cards.rule_text: When CARDNAME enters, create two 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.

cards.name: Harvest-Day Foreman
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {G}.
Tap two untapped creature tokens you control: Add one mana of any color.

cards.name: Bonfire Instigator
cards.rule_text: Whenever a creature token you control dies, CARDNAME deals 1 damage to any target.

cards.name: Many-Rooted Guardian
cards.rule_text:
Convoke
Trample
Other creatures you control get +1/+1.
cards.flavor_text: Every sapling in the village calls it grandmother.

cards.name: Hearthguard Muster
cards.rule_text:
Convoke
Create four 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens with vigilance.

cards.name: Stir the Tavern Crowd
cards.rule_text: Create X 1/1 red Goblin creature tokens, where X is 1 plus the number of opponents you have. They gain haste until end of turn.
cards.flavor_text: One shout, one spilt drink, and the whole room is on its feet.

cards.name: Stampede at the Gates
cards.rule_text:
Convoke
Creatures you control get +2/+2 and gain trample until end of turn.

cards.name: Chorus of the Crowded Field
cards.rule_text:
Creatures you control get +1/+1.
As long as you control ten or more creatures, creatures you control have vigilance and trample.

cards.name: Festival of Open Doors
cards.rule_text: If one or more creature tokens would be created under your control, those tokens plus an additional 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token are created instead.

cards.name: Welcome at Every Hearth
cards.rule_text: Whenever one or more creature tokens you control enter, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.

cards.name: Hammering War-Drums
cards.rule_text:
Creatures you control have haste.
Whenever a creature token you control attacks, it gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Shieldwall of the Many
cards.rule_text: Creatures you control gain indestructible until end of turn. If you control five or more creatures, draw a card.
cards.flavor_text: Alone, a shield. Together, a wall.

cards.name: Hail of Thrown Stones
cards.rule_text: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the number of creatures you control.

cards.name: Encircled by the Crowd
cards.rule_text:
Convoke
Exile target creature or enchantment.

cards.name: Liora, Voice of the Gathered
cards.rule_text:
+1: Create a 1/1 green and white Citizen creature token.
−2: Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
−6: You get an emblem with "Creature tokens you control get +2/+2 and have trample."

cards.name: Gathering-Call Horn
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{4}, {T}: Create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.

cards.name: Market Square of Many Roads
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{3}{G}{W}, {T}: Create two 1/1 green and white Citizen creature tokens. Activate only as a sorcery.
